title: Pure Light and Darkness Dragon
summary: The 2024 Light and Darkness Dragon cards with generic Level 8 Dragons and staples; the page's Chaos engine is left out. The strategy centers on banishing Level 8 Dragons from the Extra Deck to summon Sublimation and Evaporation, Fusion Summoning into the omni-negating Light and Darkness Dragonlord.

summary.title: Starters & Extenders
points: Light End Sublimation Dragon: Banishes a Level 8 Dragon from the Extra Deck to Special Summon itself, then performs a Fusion Summon using monsters from hand or field.
Dark End Evaporation Dragon: Banishes a Level 8 Dragon from the Extra Deck to Special Summon itself, then either performs a Fusion Summon or destroys a monster on the field.
Knight Armed Dragon, the Armored Knight Dragon: Summons itself when a Level 5 or higher Dragon is Special Summoned, matching the Level of a banished Dragon.
Dragon's Light and Darkness: Quick-Play Spell that tributes a Level 8 Dragon to search or summon a Level 8 Dragon of the opposite Attribute (LIGHT or DARK), or grants ATK and battle protection.

summary.title: Opening: Extra Deck Banish into Dragonlord
steps: Activate Light End Sublimation Dragon in hand, banishing a Level 8 LIGHT Dragon like Light End Dragon from the Extra Deck to Special Summon itself.
Trigger Sublimation's second effect to Fusion Summon using Sublimation on field and Dark End Evaporation Dragon or another DARK Dragon from hand.
Alternatively, banish a Level 8 DARK Dragon like Dark End Dragon to summon Evaporation, then activate its Fusion effect using both Sublimation and Evaporation.
Fusion Summon Light and Darkness Dragonlord using one Level 8 LIGHT Dragon and one Level 8 DARK Dragon.
If Knight Armed Dragon, the Armored Knight Dragon is in hand, trigger its summon alongside your Dragons to build Rank 8 Xyz plays.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoffs
points: Light and Darkness Dragonlord: Formidable Fusion boss that negates any Spell, Trap, or monster effect activation up to three times per turn by losing 1000 ATK/DEF, and revives any Dragon from your GY when destroyed by the opponent.
Light and Darkness Dragon: Classic Main Deck boss that automatically negates activations by dropping 500 ATK/DEF and destroys your field to revive a monster when destroyed.
Khaos Starsource Dragon: Level 8 Fusion Dragon that destroys cards on the field equal to the number of LIGHT and DARK monsters used as material.
Chaos Dragon Levianeer: Banishes three LIGHT and DARK monsters from the GY to destroy two cards without targeting.

summary.title: Rank 8 Toolbox
points: Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy: Negates Spell cards or effects on the field and attaches them as Xyz material.
Number 97: Draglubion: Untargetable Dragon Xyz that attaches materials to cheat out Number 38 or Number 46: Dragluon.
Indigo-Eyes Silver Dragon: Rank 8 Dragon that negates all other face-up cards currently on the field upon summon.

summary.title: Left out
points: Chaos Space, Starliege Seyfert, White Dragon Wyverburster, and Black Dragon Collapserpent: Omitted to keep the build strictly focused on Level 8 Dragon synergies and the 2024 Light and Darkness support.
